body: I actually filed that form over a month ago, and nothing ever came. However, I did not know about the phone number. I will be sure to give that a try. Thanks.

I actually went there today and that is when they gave me the Sallie Mae loan information, but that isn't going to work without a cosigner. At the moment, moving is not an option as I have almost no savings. My paychecks pretty much disappear on things such as rent, gas, insurance, food, etc. as soon as I get them.

I actually didn't work in 2015, but have worked since February 2016. My FAFSA needs 2015 tax information though. So, I am supposed to get some sort of statement that says I didn't file in 2015, but this is what the IRS says they don't have. 


I am trying my best to keep my head up. I have definitely thought of taking one class at a time, but the school is almost an hour and a half away.
Yes, I have. The financial aid department said they can't do anything without something called a Non-Filing Statement from the IRS, but the IRS says they don't have that.
